summary: AbCellera Biologics filed an 8-K announcing a research collaboration with Vertex Pharmaceuticals to discover, develop, manufacture, and commercialize multispecific T-cell engagers for autoimmune diseases. AbCellera leads discovery and early development; Vertex funds all R&D costs and holds commercialization rights. No financial terms, equity stakes, or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The deal is a standard partnership, not a special situation. Watch for future milestone payments or clinical progress announcements, but there is no risk-arb angle or structural event.
